repos_data.description: A lightweight, dependency-free Golang client for the Nansen AI API. Context-aware, concurrency-safe, and fully typed, with functional options, automatic retries and exponential backoff on rate limits, and rich, typed error handling. Covers Smart Money, Token God Mode, Profiler, Portfolio, and historical backtesting endpoints.

The most comprehensive MCP server for Polymarket — 48 tools spanning direct trading, market discovery, smart money tracking, copy trading, backtesting, risk management, and portfolio optimization. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client.
